The Dark Iron Pillamaster can be found in the Dark Iron sleeping quarters of the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge. He spawns when a player who has recently stolen 20 Dark Iron Pillows on the quest Kill 'em With Sleep Deprivation leaves the immediate area. Upon killing him Pillamaster's Ornate Pillow will spawn on the ground next to his corpse. Looting it starts the quest Look at the Size of It!.
The Dark Iron Lockbox can be Pick Pocketed from Dark Iron Sappers and Dark Iron Insurgents at the Stonewrought Dam in . It contains Rune of Blade Dance.

The Dark Ritual Stone can be found in Demon Fall Ridge in . After completing The Conjuring, warlocks can begin a ritual that will spawn multiple waves of demons from the nearby portal. These demons must be slain with Drain Soul while the warlock stands in the ritual circle on the ground. Killing the final demon, the Searing Infernal, will cause a Mysterious Traveler to appear from the portal and automatically start the quest Mysterious Traveler. If multiple warlocks are participating, only the warlock who begins the ritual from the stone will get credit for completion.
